chunks: O sons, go in search of Joseph and his brother, and do not despair of the mercy of God. Only they despair of God's mercy who do not believe.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about despairing of God's mercy?
ai.summary: In this verse, God instructs Jacob’s sons to search for Joseph and Benjamin, highlighting the virtue of hope in divine mercy (rajā’) as a distinguishing trait of the faithful. Shia scholars emphasize that despair (ya’s) is not merely a psychological state but a spiritual deficiency linked to disbelief (kufr), as it implies doubt in God’s power to restore what was lost. This command serves as a practical lesson in active patience (sabr) combined with persistent effort in seeking divine relief.
